goal_text: (Reused from sequential_028) A company starts with 10,000 customers growing at a net annual rate of 18.75% (25% new - 5% churn, i.e., 1.25*0.95=1.1875). In year 3 a new product launch adds exactly 8,000 customers after that year's growth. Compute: (1) customers at end of year 1, (2) customers at end of year 2, (3) customers at end of year 3 after launch, (4) customers at end of year 5, (5) in what year does the count first exceed 50,000?
